code:
$ docker compose up -d
[+] Running 2/2

$ docker compose down
[+] Running 2/2
 ✔ Container ch06-catalog-1  Removed
 ✔ Network ch06_default      Removed
caption: Compose creates a network and every container in one command, and tears both down with the next.
